nl: Reconstruct the kill chain: list the attack stages in the order they occurred (OAuth consent, PowerShell execution, C2 beacon, lateral connection, no-MFA privilege escalation, role assumption, data exfiltration).
ontology:
OCSF ontology (OWL2QL classes + datatype properties):
@prefix :     <http://sdw.example/ocsf#> .
@prefix owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

: a owl:Ontology .

:Process a owl:Class .
:ApiEvent a owl:Class .
:Session a owl:Class .

:eventUid a owl:DatatypeProperty .
:cmdLine a owl:DatatypeProperty .
:host a owl:DatatypeProperty .
:operation a owl:DatatypeProperty .
:mfaPresent a owl:DatatypeProperty .
:actor a owl:DatatypeProperty .
:startTime a owl:DatatypeProperty .
:endTime a owl:DatatypeProperty .


OBDA mapping (table -> RDF):
[PrefixDeclaration]
:		http://sdw.example/ocsf#
xsd:		http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#

[MappingDeclaration] @collection [[
mappingId	m-process
target		:proc/{event_uid} a :Process ; :eventUid {event_uid} ; :cmdLine {cmd_line} ; :host {device_hostname} .
source		SELECT event_uid, cmd_line, device_hostname FROM process

mappingId	m-api
target		:api/{event_uid} a :ApiEvent ; :eventUid {event_uid} ; :operation {api_operation} ; :mfaPresent {mfa_present} ; :actor {actor_user_uid} .
source		SELECT event_uid, api_operation, mfa_present, actor_user_uid FROM api

mappingId	m-session
target		:sess/{event_uid} a :Session ; :eventUid {event_uid} ; :startTime {start_time} ; :endTime {end_time} ; :host {host} .
source		SELECT event_uid, start_time, end_time, host FROM session
]]
